treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Ireland and the Government of the Republic of Bulgaria for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital gains (2000)
eif_quote: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Bulgaria and the Government of Ireland for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital gains Ireland Original 05-10-2000 05-01-2001

rates.quote: the tax so charged shall not exceed: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of that other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Art. 28(2): effective in Bulgaria for WHT on amounts paid on or after 1 January 2002; in Ireland for corporation tax financial years from 1 January 2002 / income tax from 6 April 2002. Art. 11(3): interest paid to the other State's Government, local authority or Central Bank exempt (not modelled). MLI: no Revenue synthesised text published; PPT quote is the standard MLI Art. 7(1) text (taken from Revenue's IE-HU synthesised text, terminology-adjusted); PPT from-date from treaties_merged.json (2023-01-01). MLI Art. 8 (365-day holding): Ireland notified BG Art. 10(2)(a), but Bulgaria's 2017 signature-stage position reserves the entirety of Art. 8, so no holding period modelled. Bulgaria opted for the Simplified LOB; Ireland did not, so only the PPT applies.
unverified: Bulgaria's deposit-stage MLI position (image-only PDF) not read; Art. 8 reservation and PPT date rely on signature-stage position and treaties_merged.json
